title: QuotaSnapshotV1
description: ADR-0009 §1 account-level quota snapshot. Quota is counted per provider account on the provider side, so the same account seen from two runners is one pool. Read by a zero-quota probe on the runner host that holds the provider login (Codex app-server account/rateLimits/read, Claude stream-json control request get_usage); Kimi is unknown. account_ref is an irreversible sha256 digest of the provider account identity, never the raw id, email or token. status ok means the provider answered; unknown means nothing could be read (timeout, spawn failure, unparsable reply, unsupported provider); error means the provider answered with an explicit error. Unknown and error are never treated as sufficient. ordinary_usage_allowed is the provider's own flag (Codex ordinaryUsageAllowed); null means the provider did not say and must not be inferred.

account_ref.description: sha256 hex of a provider-scoped account identity; null when the account could not be identified.
